jobs.title: Product Manager- ServiceNow
jobs.description:
About Monster Energy:

Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk takers, the trailblazers, the gamechangers. We're not perfect and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. Our drive is just like our athletes, unrivaled. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become on along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.

A Day in the Life:

In the position of Product Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end ownership, design, roadmap execution, and hands-on development. Define platform strategy and actively delivers solutions. Serve as the platform authority, ensuring platform capabilities are aligned to business processes, properly engineered, and continuously enhanced to meet global enterprise needs. Accountable for delivering outcomes through a combination of direct hands-on work and oversight of vendor-delivered solutions.

The Impact You'll Make:

- ServiceNow: Own the ServiceNow platform including IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD), configuration management database (CMDB), and third-party integrations. Own and drive the ServiceNow roadmap aligned to enterprise priorities.

- Define architecture standards and governance frameworks. Translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions

- Assess existing systems and recommend upgrades, migrations, or modernization strategies.

- Govern execution across internal teams and vendors.

- Develop workflows, integrations, and data models for system. Implement integrations across enterprise systems.

- Ensure process-first design and standard workflows.

- Own vendor Delivery & statement of work (SOW) Management. Own vendor delivery under SOWs.

- Approve designs and enforce architecture standards.

- Ensure global consistency across regions and business units.

- Drive key project indicator improvements, automation, and platform adoption.

Who You Are:

- Bachelor's Degree in the field of Computer Science or related field

- 5+ years of experience in ServiceNow management

- 3-5 years of experience in owning platform operations and managing vendor delivery

- Experience in development of JavaScript, Flow Designer, Business Rules, CMDB design, CSDM, integrations

Monster Energy provides competitive total compensation. The estimated annual salary range for this position is listed below. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, qualifications, experience, and work location.

Pay Range
$104,250 — $139,000 USD
